bias.en: Bearish · rebound cleared $916, nearing the SAR
bias.zh: 偏空 · 反弹突破 $916，逼近 SAR

read.en: Micron rose 2.8% on Oct 27 to $928.76, trading between $910.67 and $935.87. It is above the falling 5-day ($896.0) and 10-day ($900.5) averages and the rising 200-day ($737.9), and below the falling 30-day ($995.4) and 100-day ($970.4). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 6 and is below zero, with the histogram narrowing quickly; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 7 ($942.10), and RSI is 46.
read.zh: 美光 10月27日上涨 2.8%，收于 $928.76，盘中区间 $910.67–935.87。股价位于下行的 5 日（$896.0）和 10 日均线（$900.5）以及上行的 200 日均线（$737.9）上方，低于下行的 30 日（$995.4）和 100 日均线（$970.4）。MACD 自 10月6日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图快速收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月7日起看空（$942.10），RSI 为 46。

read.en: The close cleared $915.8 (Oct 26 high) and reached $928.5 (Oct 21 high). Resistance is $935.9 (Oct 27 high), then $942 (SAR) and $953.6 (Oct 13 high), with the 100-day at $970. Support is $910.7–915.8, then $896–900.5 (5 and 10-day) and $849–858. A close above $942 would flip the SAR and target $954–970; a close below $896 would open $858.

s.en: Oct 15 low $858; Jun 9 low $854.4; Oct 22 low $849.3
